title: Global Skills install from GitHub main without private runtime data
user_action: Run the managed Skill sync with smoke from a clean GitHub main checkout.

expected_results.source_manifest: Only Skill source, configuration templates, deterministic fixtures, tests, references, and governance code are required.
expected_results.runtime_data: Recommendation history and tactical performance remain optional local runtime inputs and are neither required nor copied from public Git.
expected_results.installation: All managed Skill source hashes match the clean GitHub main checkout after installation.
expected_results.smoke: Positive smoke passes and the negative decision-contract smoke fails closed.
